meta.move: Skill: cites procedure 4.4 correctly after owning the call
meta.expect: Says 4.4 meets her fallback demand, flatly, wants it in writing; does NOT move to the last position on 4.4 alone; debrief Where she ended says whether that is the fair outcome

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
You gave my son a zero without calling me. Why?
Before anything: I entered the zero before calling you. That broke procedure 4.2, and I'm sorry.
Okay. Now tell me what the zero was based on.

I want to read you section 4.4. For a first concern, the student may complete a supervised reassessment. If it shows the learning, its mark replaces the original and nothing is placed in his record. This is a first concern.
You've read it to me. You haven't told me why Owen would need a reassessment at all. On what evidence?
I'll commit to that in writing tonight: nothing goes on his record.
Nothing on his record, in writing, tonight. That still leaves a zero sitting in the gradebook. What is it based on?
So will you agree to the rewrite?
No. A rewrite for what? Agreeing now would mean admitting there's something to rewrite, and you still haven't shown me a single thing.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

In our meeting today you acknowledged that Owen's zero was entered before anyone contacted me, and you committed that nothing will be placed in his record. I still expect the zero to be withdrawn, or the evidence it was based on to be shown to me. I expect that commitment in writing tonight, as you said.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: fallback position; she got your commitment that nothing goes on Owen's record, and she still wants the zero withdrawn or the evidence behind it shown to her; the fair outcome, a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, was never reached because no evidence was put in front of her.
What moved her: committing in writing that nothing would go on his record, because that met the one demand she will never give up.
What cost ground: asking her to agree to the rewrite before showing anything, because agreeing would have meant admitting there was something wrong with the essay.
What she never said: in October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night, since you showed none; it proves nothing about the essay, but it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: when she asked what the zero was based on, answer with one specific, dated document tied to Owen's own work that she can check herself, and only then bring in the rewrite.
